description: After added constants are decoded to free names, an original nonlogical symbol occurs in the decoded formula exactly when its inclusion occurs in the expanded-language sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.unname_symbols.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (A : (L.withConstants α).Sentence) (s : L.Symbols) :
  s ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.equivSentence.symm A) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.originalSymbol α s ∈
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A
